The seller: SHANGHAI EAST BEST FOREIGN TRADE CO., LTD
            RM101 13FL, 258-268 Zhaojiabang Road, Shanghai, China
            TEL: 86-21-64313715
            Hereinafter called the "Seller"
   This contract is made out by and between the Sellers and the Buyers hereby
the Sellers agree to sell and the Buyers agree to buy the under mentioned goods
on the following terms and conditions:
   1. COMMODITY – PRICE - QUANTITY:
      Products            Quantity         Amount          Term of shipping
                           (PCS)            (USD)
   Automatic Folder
    Gluer Stitcher
                             01           183230.00          CIF VIETNAM
       Machine


      Total amount: $USD 183,230.00
      In words: US Dollars One Hundred Eighty Three Thousand And Two
      Hundred Thirty Only

2. ORIGIN: China
3. SHIPMENT: By the end of April, 2024
4. PORT OF LOADING: Qingdao Port, China
5. PORT OF DISCHARGE: Cat Lai Port, Ho Chi Minh
6. PAYMENT TERMS: 100% payment after shipment by T/T
  Bank details:
  Beneficiary: SHANGHAI EAST BEST FOREIGN TRADE CO., LTD
  Bank: CITIBANK, N.A. SINGAPORE
  Agent Bank CITIBANK, N.A. NEW YORK
  A/C No 0-855727-013
  Swift code CITISGSG
     Payment must be made in accordance with the term and conditions of this
  contract without discount, offset, recoupment or counter-claim of any kind.
  All bank charges at Buyer's bank are for the account of Buyer and all bank
  charges at Seller's bank are for the account of Seller.
7. DOCUMENT:
  a. Commercial Invoice in 01 original and 03 copies issued by Seller.
  b. Full set (3/3) of original Bill of Lading plus 03 non-negotiable copies
     marked "Freight Prepaid".
  c. Packing list in 01 original and 03 copies issued by Seller.
  d. Form E issued by CCPIT.
8. Force Majeure Seller/Buyer: shall not be liable for failure or delay in
  performance of its responsibilities hereunder for any such failure or delay
  which may be caused by Acts of God, Strikes, Lockouts, Factory Breakdown
  or other Labour Disturbances, Riots or Civil commotion, War or the
  Consequences of War, Declared or Undeclared, Requisition, or Threat of
  Requisition, Governmental or other restraints affecting shipping or import
  and exchange controls or credit or governmental authority or agency, any
  export controls imposed by the governmental authority or agency of the

country of origin/exporting country, Accidents, Fires, Floods, Pandemic,
      Severe    weather or any extraordinary occurrence of any other causes
      beyond Seller/Buyer's control. Such performance will be extended by 30
      days and original shipment date will be extended accordingly.
   9. Arbitration: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this contract;
      including any question regarding its existence, validity or termination, shall
      be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration in Singapore in accordance
      with the Arbitration Rules of the Singapore International Arbitration Center
      for the time being in force which rules are deemed to be incorporated by
      reference into this clause.

   By signing this contract, previous correspondences and negotiations connected
herewith shall be null and void. This contract comes into effect from signing date,
any amendment and additional clause to these conditions shall be valid only if
made in written form and duly confirmed by both sides. Faxed/Emailed signed
contract is deemed to be valid.

For and on behalf of buyer                      For and on behalf of seller
